description: Department of Local Government Southran Province - Appointing the Vice Chairman for the Name Local Government body will be re-convened
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the reconvening of a meeting for the purpose of appointing a Vice-Chairman for a local government body (Ambalangoda Urban Council). The notice is made under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and its amendments, and the content is focused on the electoral process for a local government position. This fits the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes), which includes "Election announcements and schedules" and "Candidate nominations and registrations" for government bodies.
